== Notes ==
*Consider using with [[Plague Touch]] or [[Grenth's Fingers]] (with a [[teardown]]) to transfer the Dazed condition to foes.

==Trivia==
*During the [[Nightfall]] preview event, this skill's name was "Enadiz's Headbutt", referring to French player [[w:Zinedine Zidane|Zinedine Zidane]] who [[w:Headbutt|headbutted]] Italian Marco Materazzi during the [[w:2006 FIFA World Cup|2006 FIFA World Cup]]. "Enadiz" is Zidane spelled backwards.
*The warrior in the [[skill icon]] is wearing [[Warrior Elite Sunspear armor]]
